items.stem: Look carefully at this number pattern: 2, 8, 26, 80, …. Which of the following is the correct way of getting the FIFTEENTH number in this series?

options.label: B
options.text: Multiply the fourteenth number by 3 and add 2 to the result.

options.label: C
options.text: Multiply the fourteenth number by 5 and subtract 2 from the result.

items.answer: B. Multiply the fourteenth number by 3 and add 2 to the result.
